evidence: Current title: [Preview Pane] No Select-All/Copy for Source Files in Monaco File Explorer Preview

Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.63.0

### Installation method

PowerToys auto-update

### Running as admin

_No response_

### Area(s) with issue?

{"File Explorer"=>"Preview Pane"}

### Steps to reproduce

1) Open up a source file
2) Click in the preview pane file
3) Try and hit `Ctrl+A` to Select all text, all files selected in file explorer instead.

### ✔️ Expected Behavior

Should be able to select all text in the preview (in order to copy it) without having to use mouse and scroll through entire file (i.e. keyboard shortcut and/or context menu option)

Related to #12637 and #3526

### ❌ Actual Behavior

File Explorer gets the keyboard command and selects all files in the folder.

No option in context menu either:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8959496/198858809-1a04d5b3-ff35-43b4-8d66-facc40d95467.png)

Looks like Ctrl+C for the shortcut for copy d...
